headlines.title: Jennings sits Monday after turning down a trade back to the 49ers
headlines.summary: Vikings receiver Jauan Jennings said he turned down a trade to the 49ers because “I love where I’m at.” His production has dropped sharply: six catches for 54 yards on 10 targets over six appearances, his lowest totals through eight weeks since 2021. The Vikings are funnelling targets to Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison, and using T.J. Hockenson as a safety valve. Jennings is out with a calf strain for Monday night against the Bills.
headlines.whyItMatters: Minnesota is 6–1 and second in the NFC. Jennings’ role is small while the targets go to Jefferson and Addison.

headlines.title: Saints get Tyson and Banks back for the Browns
headlines.summary: New Orleans activated rookie receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. from injured reserve. Tyson, the Saints’ first-round pick, hasn’t played this season because of a hamstring injury and is listed as questionable. Banks started all 17 games as a rookie last year. The Saints also waived RB Kendre Miller and TE Treyton Welch. Shedeur Sanders starts for Cleveland, with Deshaun Watson in line as the backup.
headlines.whyItMatters: New Orleans is 2–5 and 15th in the NFC, so the return of two first-rounders is a real boost.

headlines.title: James Pearce is back for the Falcons after an eight-game suspension
headlines.summary: Falcons linebacker James Pearce has been moved to the active roster and is set to make his 2026 debut against the Bengals in Madrid on Sunday. He was suspended for the first eight games after a domestic violence arrest. Pearce had 10.5 sacks as a rookie. Atlanta also signed Khalil Herbert off the practice squad to take over for Brian Robinson, who is going on injured reserve.
headlines.whyItMatters: Atlanta is 3–5 and 11th in the NFC, and Pearce gives the edge rush a new option.

nba.oneThing: Luka Dončić scored a season-high 53 points as the Lakers beat the Trail Blazers 124–118, and the Lakers (8–2) now sit first in the West.

headlines.title: Dončić scores 53 as the Lakers beat Portland
headlines.summary: Luka Dončić had 53 points, five rebounds, five assists and five three-pointers in the Lakers’ 124–118 win over the Trail Blazers. Austin Reaves added 25 points and four steals. Portland’s Deni Avdija had 22 points, nine rebounds and 11 assists, and Damian Lillard scored 22, but the Blazers fell to 6–2. Dončić is averaging 40.1 points per game, the best in the league.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers are 8–2 and first in the West, and the early MVP talk is building around Dončić’s scoring.

headlines.title: Cavaliers upset the 76ers, LeBron struggles in return
headlines.summary: Cleveland beat Philadelphia 119–95, an upset because the 76ers were 8–2 and top of the East. Donovan Mitchell had 23 points, seven rebounds and eight assists, and Evan Mobley added 22 points and six rebounds. Jaylen Brown led Philadelphia with 20 points. LeBron James returned to Cleveland as a 76ers player and shot 3-for-12 with six turnovers. The Cavaliers move to 5–4.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia is still first in the East, and Cleveland is sixth.

headlines.title: Celtics beat the Hornets with a 3-point barrage
headlines.summary: Boston won 119–80 in Charlotte in the NBA Cup. Jayson Tatum scored 34 points with eight rebounds, nine assists and five threes, and Derrick White added 18 points. Charlotte, now 3–7, was missing Dennis Schröder and Kon Knueppel. Tatum said Charlotte “feels like home” after hearing “MVP” chants from the crowd.
headlines.whyItMatters: Boston is second in the East at 7–2.

headlines.title: Ajay Mitchell’s 35 leads the Thunder past Memphis
headlines.summary: Ajay Mitchell scored 35 points in the Thunder’s 128–97 win over the Grizzlies. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 28 points and four assists, and Jared McCain had 21 points and four steals. Ty Jerome led Memphis with 21 points and five assists. Oklahoma City is 7–2 and third in the West, while Memphis is 6–3 and seventh.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Thunder are one of the early contenders in the West, and Memphis is still in the top eight.

recaps.keyLine: Wembanyama 30 pts, 14 reb, 2 ast · Castle 19 pts, 3 reb, 7 ast · Acuff Jr. 22 pts, 3 reb, 8 ast · Sabonis 17 pts, 12 reb, 5 ast
recaps.text: Wembanyama was the difference in Sacramento with 30 points and 14 rebounds. Stephon Castle added seven assists and Devin Vassell hit five threes as San Antonio extended its winning streak to seven. Darius Acuff Jr. had 22 points and eight assists for the Kings, but Sacramento is 1–8.

recaps.keyLine: Mitchell 35 pts, 1 reb, 5 ast · Gilgeous-Alexander 28 pts, 3 reb, 4 ast · Jerome 21 pts, 2 reb, 5 ast · Edey 14 pts, 6 reb, 1 ast
recaps.text: Mitchell did the heavy lifting with 35 points, and Gilgeous-Alexander added 28. McCain’s 21 points and four steals gave Oklahoma City more depth. Memphis got 21 points from Ty Jerome and 14 from Zach Edey, but couldn’t keep pace.

recaps.keyLine: Barrett 27 pts, 7 reb, 4 ast · Martin 27 pts, 4 reb, 1 ast, 6 3PM · Herro 23 pts, 5 reb, 10 ast · Burries 21 pts, 11 reb, 6 ast
recaps.text: Jamal Shead was the story with 16 assists. RJ Barrett and Alijah Martin each scored 27 for Toronto, and Martin hit six threes. Milwaukee is 1–8 and has lost five straight, but Tyler Herro’s 23 points and 10 assists and Brayden Burries’ 11 rebounds kept the Bucks in it for a while.

recaps.keyLine: Brown 20 pts, 5 reb, 5 ast · Edgecombe 19 pts, 3 reb, 2 ast, 4 stl · Mitchell 23 pts, 7 reb, 8 ast · Mobley 22 pts, 6 reb, 4 ast
recaps.text: Donovan Mitchell (23 points, eight assists) and Evan Mobley (22 points) carried Cleveland, while Harden added 17 points and six rebounds. Philadelphia had Jaylen Brown (20 points, five assists) and VJ Edgecombe (four steals), but it was Cleveland’s scoring that won the night.

contextCard.title: How the NBA trade deadline works
contextCard.body: Teams can trade players and picks up to a set date in the middle of the season, usually in February. After that, most trades are blocked until the season ends. Teams that want to move a player have to do it before the deadline.
